message.content: The illustration depicts two human figures and a large animal against a light gray background. In the upper center, a man with a smile sits atop a dark brown bull. He wears a white, long-sleeved shirt, a black cap, and a purple and pink patterned scarf around his shoulders. To the lower left, a woman in a red short-sleeved shirt and glasses stands holding a dark green rope that is looped through the bull’s nose ring. The bull has large, curved black horns and a ring in its nose. The man’s right hand rests on the bull’s back. The woman’s left hand grips the rope lower down, while her right hand holds it higher up. Above the main image, large black text reads "TEMPO" across the center. Smaller white text at the top reads "BOY THOHIR DAN SUAP SKK MIGAS" and "DISKON HUKUMAN DJOKO SUSILO". To the right of the man, white text says "MENIMANG JOKOWI" above "EDISI 9-15 SEPTEMBER 2013". A barcode and price information are in the bottom right corner.
